name: BTCPay Server
description: Self-hosted Bitcoin and cryptocurrency payment processor for merchants.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      BTCPAY_POSTGRES: "User ID=btcpayserver;Password={{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}};Host={{serviceName}}-postgres;Port=5432;Database=btcpayserver"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      BTCPAY_NETWORK: {{env.BTCPAY_NETWORK}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/datadir
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: btcpayserver
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: btcpayserver
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
